operators.name: custom_cat

parameters.name: x1
parameters.shape: same as first input tensor in forward

parameters.name: x2
parameters.shape: same as second input tensor in forward

returns.shape: same as torch.cat output: concatenation of x1 and x2 along dim

semantics: Preserves the original tensor traversal order: elements of x1 appear first, then elements of x2 along the concatenation dimension
Supports arbitrary strides; the implementation must either handle strided tensors correctly or explicitly make a contiguous copy before concatenation
The output tensor is allocated on the current CUDA device with the same dtype as the inputs
No broadcasting is performed; both inputs must have identical shapes except in the concatenation dimension
Concatenates x1 and x2 along dimension self.dim (which is 1 for the reference config)
Output shape [512, 128, 128, 128], dtype float32, device cuda:0
No additional computation; the result is the final return value
